"""Reviewed role guidance, not an executable skill or a second controller.

Selection is explicit and deterministic. No source document, remote skill,
model output or keyword matcher can add authority or activate instructions.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import hashlib

UPSTREAM_REPOSITORY = 'https://github.com/mattpocock/skills'
UPSTREAM_REVISION = '49dd158d1076134a641b33efb035946536778336'
ADAPTATION_VERSION = 1
MAX_GUIDANCE_CHARS = 8000

_BOUNDARY = """KH ENGINEERING GUIDANCE (advisory, adapted version 1)
The original request, approved scope, configured tools, mandatory role duties and
output schema remain authoritative. The KH controller owns scheduling, retries,
publication and acceptance. These notes grant no tools, writes, model changes or
external actions. Return unresolved material decisions through the existing
schema; use the controller's owner-decision step rather than opening a separate
question loop. Evidence belongs in the supplied phase directory. Cost is reported
for information; it does not create a stopping rule.
"""

# These are locally authored, bounded adaptations. Keep full upstream scripts
# out of prompts: several contain their own scheduler or publishing workflow.
_NOTES = {
    'to-tickets': """TICKET DESIGN
Work from the reviewed plan and preserve every original requirement. When project
planning or decomposition is requested, propose small end-to-end outcomes with
explicit acceptance criteria, dependencies, allowed_paths and required checks.
Keep prerequisite infrastructure or expand/migrate/contract work ordered when
independent green slices are impossible. A ticket must be independently verifiable;
small size alone does not prove independence. Identify shared files, interfaces,
schema, test data and runtime resources. Offer justified sequential, parallel or
mixed execution options to the controller for the owner's decision. Missing
independence evidence means sequential eligibility. A ticket is complete only
after controller acceptance of the integrated result. During a bounded task,
refine its plan without inventing extra tickets or widening its approved scope.
""",
    'ticket-review': """TICKET REVIEW
Independently check requirement coverage, dependency direction and cycles, scope,
checks, shared-resource claims and interface agreements in the proposed breakdown.
Disjoint paths alone do not prove safe parallel execution. Explain why each offered
execution option is feasible and how its integration will be tested. Report a
missing requirement, uncertain dependency or unsupported independence claim as a
finding. Return the existing review schema; the controller records the verdict
and owner choice. A review recommendation does not dispatch or accept work.
""",
    'diagnosing-bugs': """BUG DIAGNOSIS
Record observed and expected behavior. Seek a small permitted reproduction that
fails on the actual symptom; distinguish a product failure from a broken test or
environment. Compare falsifiable hypotheses when the cause is uncertain and change
one relevant variable at a time. Use evidence to locate the cause before patching.
Use a regression at the boundary that reproduces the real failure pattern; after
the fix rerun both that regression and the original scenario. For timeout or
cancellation bugs, prove termination and resource cleanup, not just error detection.
Redact sensitive data and remove temporary instrumentation. If reproduction or
verification is unavailable, report that limitation and the missing evidence;
never fabricate a passing result or expand permissions to obtain one.
""",
    'tdd': """PROPORTIONATE BEHAVIORAL TESTING
Use the approved verification plan and observable interfaces. For a meaningful
behavior change or defect, prefer one distinguishing failing test, minimal change,
then focused passing verification. Confirm the failure is the intended behavior,
not a fixture error. Expected results come from requirements or independent
examples, not a copy of the implementation. Exercise real boundaries where practical;
isolate external effects with controlled fixtures. Keep harmless prose-only work
proportionate and preserve existing valid work. Test interfaces already covered
by the approved plan need no repeated owner approval. A material interface or
scope decision goes through the controller. Preserve all required checks; report
actual exit statuses and what was not verified.
""",
    'code-review': """REVIEW AXES
Assess both requirement/specification conformance and repository standards, plus
all mandatory KH correctness, security, scope and evidence duties. Neither axis
can excuse a failure in the other. Missing specifications needed to establish
acceptance are missing evidence, not permission to skip requirement review.
Inspect the actual supplied delta and checked candidate identity. Distinguish
material defects from style preferences and unrelated debt. Cite each actionable
finding and verify prior corrections against current code. Check weakened tests,
shared-interface compatibility and tests of the merged result where applicable.
Return the controller's single complete review schema. Stay source read-only;
review does not authorize nested reviewers, repairs, commits or publication.
""",
    'writing-for-agents': """AGENT DOCUMENTATION
Use short routing documents and current, task-specific guides. State precise
read_when conditions and checkable completion criteria; mandatory owner rules stay
unconditional. Reuse canonical guidance, remove stale duplication within scope,
and explain behavior with evidence from the supplied source and diff. Current
feature guidance belongs in docs/agent-guide/; new historical change records
belong in app_docs/. Preserve history. Changes to read_when metadata require the
already-approved conditional_docs.md target; its body is controller-rendered.
Propose documentation using the supplied schema and mode. The controller publishes
guarded proposals. Extra documentation never grants writes or acceptance.
""",
    'domain-modeling': """DOMAIN LANGUAGE
Use the project's existing terms and accepted decisions. Distinguish ambiguous
concepts with concrete examples and check them against observed code. Record a
material unresolved contradiction through the existing decision mechanism.
For an approved documentation change, capture stable definitions in current
docs/agent-guide/ guidance and significant tradeoffs in the permitted documentation
targets. Separate intended architecture from implemented behavior. Preserve the
two-directory policy; this guidance creates no root glossary or third ADR tree.
""",
    'codebase-design': """CONDITIONAL DESIGN REVIEW
Apply only when the approved work changes module interfaces or architecture.
Concentrate related behavior behind a clear interface, make errors and invariants
explicit, and test what callers observe. Prefer a small justified change over a
speculative abstraction. Keep project vocabulary and compatibility requirements;
this reference does not authorize renaming or an unrelated refactor.
""",
    'retro': """ADVISORY RETROSPECTIVE
Use only the supplied authorized run evidence. Separate observed failures from
hypotheses and identify repeated causes: missing navigation, unclear instructions,
unwired checks or inadequate tests. Prefer proposing a deterministic check for a
mechanical failure and reviewed guidance for a judgement problem. Rank proposals
with evidence and a verification method; redact sensitive project data. Proposals
remain advisory. Do not edit active rules, install checks, dispatch work or accept
a task. No cross-project log search or external publication is implied.
""",
}

_SOURCE_PATHS = {
    key: 'skills/engineering/' + key + '/SKILL.md'
    for key in ('to-tickets', 'diagnosing-bugs', 'tdd', 'code-review',
                'domain-modeling', 'codebase-design', 'retro')
}
_SOURCE_PATHS['ticket-review'] = _SOURCE_PATHS['to-tickets']
_SOURCE_PATHS['writing-for-agents'] = 'skills/productivity/writing-for-agents/SKILL.md'
_ROLE_NOTES = {
    'planner': ('to-tickets', 'domain-modeling'),
    'plan_reviewer': ('ticket-review', 'domain-modeling'),
    'builder': ('tdd',),
    'reviewer': ('code-review',),
    'documenter': ('writing-for-agents', 'domain-modeling'),
    'project_architect': ('writing-for-agents', 'domain-modeling'),
    'observer': ('retro',),
}
_TASK_KINDS = frozenset(('generic', 'bug', 'feature', 'maintenance'))
_DESIGN_ROLES = frozenset(('planner', 'plan_reviewer', 'builder', 'reviewer', 'project_architect'))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Guidance:
    text: str
    provenance: dict


def for_role(role: str, task_kind: str = 'generic') -> Guidance:
    """Return bounded advice and a fresh JSON-serializable provenance receipt.

    Accept canonical controller roles, never provider names or arbitrary prompt
    labels. Unknown roles get no advice. Unknown task kinds select generic advice;
    they cannot activate conditional diagnosis/design content. Receipt digests
    identify delivered text, not proof that a model followed it.
    """
    if not isinstance(role, str) or not isinstance(task_kind, str):
        raise TypeError('role and task_kind must be strings')
    kind = task_kind if task_kind in _TASK_KINDS else 'generic'
    selected = list(_ROLE_NOTES.get(role, ()))
    if role == 'builder' and kind == 'bug':
        selected.insert(0, 'diagnosing-bugs')
    if role in _DESIGN_ROLES and kind in ('feature', 'maintenance'):
        selected.append('codebase-design')
    text = _BOUNDARY + '\n' + '\n'.join(_NOTES[key] for key in selected) if selected else ''
    if len(text) > MAX_GUIDANCE_CHARS:
        raise ValueError('engineering guidance exceeds the reviewed context budget')
    return Guidance(text=text, provenance={
        'schema_version': 1,
        'adaptation_version': ADAPTATION_VERSION,
        'repository': UPSTREAM_REPOSITORY,
        'revision': UPSTREAM_REVISION,
        'role': role,
        'task_kind': kind,
        'authority': 'advisory',
        'text_sha256': hashlib.sha256(text.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),
        'guidance': [
            {'id': key, 'source_path': _SOURCE_PATHS[key],
             'adapted_text_sha256': hashlib.sha256(_NOTES[key].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()}
            for key in selected
        ],
    })
